revised_hypothesis: There is no established single evolutionary progression from mechanical names to symbolism. Acronyms, persona names, literary references and chemical names have overlapped for many decades. Convergence can be evaluated by meaningful structural correspondence and documented transmission, not semantic theme recurrence alone.
negative_controls: DENDRAL's botanical metaphor directly describes a tree search algorithm, providing positive design-grounding standard.
Sora's first-person narrative shows an evocative name may be selected under ordinary launch-time brainstorming, not a deep previously established architecture.
Anthropic 2024 rhetoric study predates later conversations about private corpuses; shared words may have independent history.
Internal model names can be remapped before public launch, as in reported Barium-B / Argon discrepancy.
